description: Runs windowed games as borderless fullscreen windows, so Alt-Tab is instant. Legacy free edition, final release.
notes: This is the legacy edition: 9.6.0 is its final release and it gets no more updates.
The maintained rewrite (10.x) is paid and sold only on Steam (app 388080); it is not in this package.
Needs .NET Framework 4.8 (built into Windows 10 1903 and newer).
Settings, the language files and logs live in %APPDATA%\Andrew Sampson\Borderless Gaming, outside the Scoop folder:
they survive updates and are kept on uninstall (delete that folder by hand if you want them gone).
A copy installed with the upstream setup uses the same folder, so moving to Scoop keeps your window list.
'Run on startup' creates the scheduled task 'BorderlessGaming' (highest privileges) pointing at the Scoop copy;
'scoop uninstall' removes it when it points into this package's folder (from an elevated shell, if Windows asks).
pre_install: # The upstream Inno Setup installer (also used by Chocolatey) would be a second copy outside Scoop.

error "Borderless Gaming is already installed outside Scoop ($($setupCopy.InstallLocation)). Remove it first in Settings > Apps; your settings in %APPDATA%\Andrew Sampson\Borderless Gaming stay either way. This attempt left a failed install behind: the next 'scoop install' cleans it up, or run 'scoop uninstall $app'."
# A fresh install stops if Borderless Gaming runs from anywhere (scripts/common/Test-AppBusy.ps1).
# Updates are checked in pre_uninstall, which Scoop runs before it removes the old version.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { error "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$busyCheck' is missing."; break }
if ($busy) { error "$app is running. Close it (tray icon > Exit) and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }
pre_uninstall: # 'scoop update' and 'scoop uninstall' stop here, before anything is removed, while Borderless Gaming runs.
# Without the helper (e.g. the bucket was removed) only warn: uninstalling must stay possible.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { warn "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$busyCheck' is missing."; return }
if ($busy) { error "$app is running. Close it (tray icon > Exit) and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }

script: # Only on 'scoop uninstall': the 'Run on startup' task points at 'current', which stays valid across updates.
if (!$ours) { info "The scheduled task 'BorderlessGaming' starts another copy ($($task.Actions[0].Execute)); left as it is."; return }
try { Unregister-ScheduledTask -InputObject $task -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop; info "Removed the 'Run on startup' task 'BorderlessGaming'." }
catch { warn "Could not remove the scheduled task 'BorderlessGaming' (it runs with highest privileges). From an elevated shell: Unregister-ScheduledTask BorderlessGaming" }
# The legacy site names the setup after the short version (9.6 for 9.6.0); pad it to three parts like the git tags.
if ($page -notmatch 'BorderlessGaming(?<file>\d+(?:\.\d+)+)_admin_setup\.exe') { throw 'No setup link on legacy.borderlessgam.ing' }
